what: Drift probe resolves lib via unset PLUGIN_ROOT under set -u
scenario_or_breakage: Plan places the probe inside the JQ_AVAILABLE && GIT_AVAILABLE block before HOOK_CWD parsing; PLUGIN_ROOT is only assigned inside the later if [[ -n "$HOOK_CWD" ]] block. set +e does not disable set -u, so expanding "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib-sparse-dirs.sh" aborts SessionStart before exit 0
suggested_fix: At probe entry bind plugin_root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd -P)}" (or source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib-sparse-dirs.sh" directly) before any PLUGIN_ROOT expansion; keep the probe cwd-independent of HOOK_CWD

what: Subshell-only wrapper is insufficient for missing normalize_sparse_dirs
scenario_or_breakage: Plan allows "set +e … set -e or a subshell". A bare ( … ) inherits set -euo pipefail; calling an undefined normalize_sparse_dirs after a silent source still exits 127 and kills the subshell; parent continues but a top-level probe without an inner set +e still violates exit 0 if any step escapes the subshell
suggested_fix: Treat subshell as requiring inner set +e, or match existing line 127-129: source … || true then declare -F normalize_sparse_dirs before expected=$(normalize_sparse_dirs …); alternatively expected=$(normalize_sparse_dirs 2>/dev/null || true) so missing lib skips without a set +e envelope
